title: ✨ FAITH IN MOTION ✨ Every sunrise reminds me that His mercy never runs out.
paragraphs:
✨ FAITH IN MOTION ✨
Every sunrise reminds me that His mercy never runs out.
This birthday isn’t just another year older — it’s another year deeper in grace, stronger in faith, and brighter in purpose. 🌅💛
“Those who look to Him are radiant; their faces are never covered with shame.” – Psalm 34 : 5
